auth.closed: Sign-up is closed on this instance

auth.resetDone: Your password has been updated. You can log in now.
auth.resetInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

onboarding.title: Set up your restaurant
onboarding.subtitle: Two quick steps and your booking widget is live.
onboarding.name: Restaurant name
onboarding.serviceIntro: A service is a bookable period, like Lunch or Dinner. You can add more later.

today.title: Bookings
today.cancelReasonHint: Sent to the guest in the cancellation email when they have an address.
today.seatAnyway: Seat here anyway (the table is taken at that time)

services.title: Services
services.description: Bookable periods with their own hours and pacing.
services.name: Name
services.empty: No services yet. Add one so guests can book.
services.coversHint: Guests that may arrive within one slot interval. Leave empty for no limit.
services.lastSeating: Times are first and last bookable arrival.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the saved value
notifications.instanceHint: Falls back to the server-wide SMTP settings until you configure one here.
notifications.rulesHint: Choose which messages go out on each channel. SMS only works once an SMS provider is configured.

widget.title: Widget & booking rules
widget.embedHint: Paste this where the booking form should appear on your website.
widget.largePartyHint: Leave empty to confirm every size automatically.
widget.waitlistHint: When a date is full, guests can leave their details from the widget. Freed tables can be offered to them automatically, first come first served; an offer that is not accepted in time moves on to the next guest.

customers.title: Customers
customers.search: Search by name, email or phone
customers.empty: No guests yet. They appear here after their first booking.
customers.name: Name
customers.notesHint: Only staff can see this: allergies, preferences, seating wishes.
customers.tagHint: Press Enter to add. Tags help you filter regulars, VIPs, allergies…
customers.deleteHint: Removes contact details, notes and tags. Bookings are kept under an anonymous guest.
customers.confirmDelete: Delete this guest and their personal data?
customers.invalidPhone: The phone number is not valid.

closures.title: Closures & capacity
closures.exceptionsHint: Override the weekly hours on specific dates: holidays, private events, extended hours.
closures.empty: No closures or special hours planned.
closures.rulesHint: Extra limits on top of each service's pacing: fewer covers on a quiet Monday, a cap on Saturday nights, a smaller max party in a corner area.
closures.emptyRules: No capacity rules. Services use their own limits.
closures.name: Name (optional)
closures.areasHint: Optional zones guests can ask for (terrace, garden, private room). Capacity rules can target them.

team.title: Team
team.membersHint: Everyone with access to {{organization}}. Owners manage billing and the team, managers run the restaurant, staff handle bookings.
team.inviteHint: They get an email with a link. The invitation is valid for 48 hours.
team.alreadyMember: This person is already on the team.
team.noProviderHint: If no email provider is configured the invitation is still created: share the link from the pending list.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.hint: Keys belong to the whole organization and act with manager permissions. Use them from a POS, your website or scripts with the X-Api-Key header.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.createdHint: This is the only time it is shown. Store it somewhere safe.
apiKeys.confirmRevoke: Revoke this key? Integrations using it stop working immediately.

invite.title: You have been invited
invite.introNoInviter: You were invited to join {{organization}} as {{role}}.
invite.signupFirst: Create an account with {{email}} or log in to accept.
invite.wrongAccount: You are logged in as {{current}}, but this invitation was sent to {{email}}. Log out and use the invited address.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask for a new one.
invite.used: This invitation is no longer valid.

restaurant.title: Restaurant
restaurant.profileHint: Shown to guests in emails and on the booking page.
restaurant.name: Name
restaurant.slugHint: Changing it breaks embed codes and links already shared.
restaurant.emailHint: Staff alerts and guest replies go here.

bookings.title: Bookings
bookings.search: Search by guest, phone, email or code

templates.hint: Rewrite any message in your own words. Placeholders in double braces are replaced when the message goes out; the booking details table and the manage button stay.
templates.subject: Subject
templates.heading: Heading
templates.confirmReset: Discard your wording and go back to the default text?

analytics.title: Analytics

kpiHint.occupancyUnknown: set max covers per slot on your services

analytics.coversPerDayHint: Bars show covers seated or expected; the grey track is the capacity offered that day.
analytics.byPartySizeHint: Share of bookings by number of guests.
analytics.leadTimeMedian: Guests book {{median}} ahead on average (median); mean {{average}}.

waitlist.title: Waitlist
waitlist.empty: Nobody is waiting on this day.
waitlist.offerHint: The guest gets a link to confirm the table. The offer stays open for {{minutes}} minutes.
waitlist.bookHint: Creates a confirmed booking right away and notifies the guest.
waitlist.confirmRemove: Remove this guest from the waitlist?

tables.title: Tables
tables.hint: Tables are matched to bookings automatically: the smallest free table that fits, or two joinable tables of the same area pushed together. Once you add tables, a time is only bookable if a table is free for the whole visit.
tables.name: Name
tables.joinableHint: Joinable tables in the same area can be combined for larger parties.
tables.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers are preferred when several tables fit.
tables.empty: No tables yet. Add your first table to start assigning bookings to tables.
tables.floorPlanHint: Drag tables to arrange the room, then save the layout. Click a table to edit it.

payments.title: Payments
payments.stripeHint: Connect your Stripe account to take deposits or hold a card against no-shows. Keys are stored encrypted.
payments.secretSet: Set (ends in {{last4}}). Paste a new key to replace it.
payments.secretUnset: From the Stripe dashboard → Developers → API keys.
payments.webhookHint: Optional but recommended: add the URL below as a webhook endpoint in Stripe and paste its signing secret here.
payments.webhookEvents: Events to send: checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded, checkout.session.expired. Without a webhook, payments are still settled when the guest returns to the booking page or when the payment window closes.
payments.policyHint: Applies to online bookings only. Staff bookings never ask for a payment.

modes.card_hold: A card as guarantee, charged only on no-show

modeHint.deposit: The booking stays pending until the deposit is paid through Stripe Checkout; it lapses if the guest does not pay in time.
modeHint.card_hold: The guest saves a card at booking time. Nothing is charged unless the booking is marked as no-show.

payments.windowHint: Deposits only: the booking is cancelled if unpaid after this.
payments.refundOnCancel: Refund the deposit automatically when a booking is cancelled
payments.chargeNoShow: Charge the fee automatically on no-show
